gates.requirement: Occurrence, semantic, and byte identities remain non-substitutable; equal semantics and equal bytes do not merge records.
SQLite records, lineage edges, and events are transactional, immutable, reference-closed, ordered, and traversable.
Zarr v3 arrays bind coordinates and every file or chunk to a deterministic manifest; verified bounded slices reject tampering.
Private bundles are deterministic, checksum-closed, symlink-free, relocatable, and preserve extensions and withheld states.
P3 Python and CLI operations return the exact OperationResult envelope and normative exit classes.
